notes: Same initialization and fixed bank within each paired setting.
Timings measure all optimizer stages, excluding shared setup/evaluation/plots and one-time optimizer imports.
Relative objective gaps are computed within the same method; absolute losses across different methods are not comparable.
Supplementary synthetic three-seed run preceded separate gradient-evaluation logging; it uses the identical optimizer updates.
Checks are at equal-weight centers, not full grids; time ratios are CPU diagnostic measurements, not universal speedups.
Supplementary synthetic total evaluation counts omit the first no-gradient initial loss; final seed-0 counts include it.
